title: TextEDA IR v0.8 — component shard
description: Semantic projection of one .teda component file. Pins must already be materialized in the IR: inline pins are copied verbatim; when `symbol` points to a third-party library that carries pin facts and the file omits `pins`, the parser expands them from the library and `pins_source` records the source. A self-built `symbol` stores only the view, without pin facts (ADR-0012), so a component pointing at a self-built symbol must inline `pins`.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard; see teda.md §13.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

component.description: The component itself: id, classification, library references and the materialized pin table.

id.description: Equals the file name without the extension; not a relative path.

kind.description: Which kind of device this is (ADR-0027, ADR-0037): a part is one purchasable device named by its part number, a generic is a device class whose value lives in the instances row. Never inferred.

mpn.description: Manufacturer part number; required for a part, absent for a generic (ADR-0027).

category.description: Open value set: mcu / resistor / capacitor / inductor / led / diode / mosfet_p / regulator / battery_charger / …. Used only for classification; whether a part number is required follows from the kind, not from the category (ADR-0027).

construction.description: The technology of the generic (ADR-0027): mlcc, tantalum, film, shielded, .... Required for a generic, absent for a part. Open value set.

polarized.description: Whether the generic is polarised (ADR-0027). Required for a generic, absent for a part.

description.description: One-line human description of the device (e.g. `SOT-23-5 500 mA LDO`). Prose only: it never participates in a check and never changes identity.

symbol.description: Symbol library reference lib:name; a self-built symbol stores only the view, without pin facts.

footprint.description: Footprint library reference lib:name; geometry is a fact of the component library and does not enter the board description.

params.description: Declares the extra columns allowed in instances rows; the order is the column order; required must precede optional (teda.md §12).

ratings.description: The part's own ratings, one row per role (ADR-0039). Absent for a generic: a class has no ratings of its own, its requirements live in the instances rows.

pins.description: Pin table; pin numbers are unique and form the key that aligns with the footprint.

pins_source.description: inline = the file has a pins section (inline wins); symbol = the file omits pins and the pins are resolved from a third-party library that carries pin facts (a self-built symbol has no pin facts and cannot be this source). When both are present, inline is taken; the difference is reported by validation and does not enter the IR.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute.

name.description: Parameter name, matching the column name declared in the component's params section.

type.description: Parameter type; determines the unit of this column's integer values.

required.description: Whether this column is required; required columns must precede optional ones.

param_type.description: The parameter type determines the integer unit in the IR: resistance→µΩ, capacitance→fF, inductance→pH, voltage→µV, current→nA, power→µW, frequency→mHz, length→nm, temperature→m°C, percent→ppm, integer→1. See ADR-0008 decision 4.

number.description: Key matching the footprint pad; part of the identity.

name.description: Human-readable function name; reused functions go in alternates.

electrical_type.description: Pin electrical type, e.g. input, power_in, passive.

unit.description: Unit number of a multi-unit device; defaults to 1.

alternates.description: Alternate function name, e.g. BOOT in GPIO0/BOOT.

rating.description: One rating of a part: the role, the quantity it is measured in, and the value (ADR-0039). A part states its own ratings; a generic states none, because its requirements live in the instances rows.

name.description: The rating role, from the closed role vocabulary (teda.md §6.2.1).

type.description: The quantity the role is measured in; the unit of the integer value.

value.description: The rating, in the canonical unit of the type (resistance→µΩ, percent→ppm, …; see ADR-0008 decision 4).

name.description: The rating role, from the closed role vocabulary (teda.md §6.2.1).

type.description: The quantity the role is measured in; the value is a code, not a number.

text.description: The rating as a code, e.g. a dielectric class (X7R). The set is closed; the spelling is exact.
